```{r}
library(sf)

library(lwgeom)
library(rmapshaper)
library(osmdata)
load('sample_data.rda')
```

```{r}
reproj <- sf::st_transform(result, 4326)
bbox <- sf::st_bbox(reproj)
boundary <- sf::st_as_sfc(sf::st_bbox(result))
# landuse <- overturemapsr::record_batch_reader(schema_type='land_use', bbox = as.vector(bbox))
lines <- overturemapsr::record_batch_reader(schema_type='segment', bbox = as.vector(bbox))
lines_filtered <- subset(lines, subclass != 'crosswalk')
```

```{r}
lines_to_split <- lines %>% 
  st_transform(st_crs(result)) %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_line_merge()

# Step 4: Split city polygon using roads
split_result <- st_split(boundary, lines_to_split)
boundary_polygons <- st_collection_extract(split_result, "POLYGON")
boundary_polygons <- sf::st_as_sf(boundary_polygons)
```


```{r}
# DBSCAN model
coords <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(result))
db_result <- dbscan::dbscan(coords, eps = 50, minPts = 3)
result$cluster <- db_result$cluster

new_polygons <- list()

# Iterate over clusters
for (cl in unique(result$cluster[result$cluster != 0])) {
  cluster_result <- result[result$cluster == cl, ]

  # Find closest result to boundary
  nearest_idx <- st_nearest_feature(cluster_result, boundary)
  closest_result_cluster <- cluster_result[nearest_idx, ]

  # Convex hull around closest result
  closest_boundary <- st_convex_hull(st_union(closest_result_cluster))

  # Convert convex to approximate rectangle
  result_rectangle_boundary <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(closest_boundary))

  # Get edge points (corners of rectangle)
  edge_coords <- st_coordinates(result_rectangle_boundary)[1:4, ]
  edge_points <- st_sfc(lapply(1:4, function(i) st_point(edge_coords[i, ])), crs = st_crs(result))

  # Connect edge to boundary and update boundary shape
  for (p_edge in edge_points) {
    p_edge <- st_sfc(p_edge, crs = st_crs(edge_points))
    p_edge <- st_transform(p_edge, st_crs(boundary))
    # Nearest point on the outer boundary
    p_edge <- st_zm(p_edge)            # drop Z/M from point
    boundary <- st_zm(boundary)        # drop Z/M from boundary if needed

    nearest_pt <- st_nearest_points(p_edge, boundary)
    p_boundary <- st_cast(nearest_pt, "POINT")[2]
    
    # Line scaled 1.2x (not direct in R, approximate by buffering)
    conn_line <- st_sfc(st_linestring(rbind(st_coordinates(p_edge), 
                                            st_coordinates(p_boundary))), 
                        crs = st_crs(boundary))
    # You could buffer this if scale needed:
    # conn_line <- st_buffer(conn_line, dist = 1.2)
    
    # Union line with current building boundary
    result_rectangle_boundary <- st_union(result_rectangle_boundary, conn_line)
  }

  # Subtract current boundary rectangle from original boundary
  boundary <- st_difference(boundary, result_rectangle_boundary)

  # Store new polygon
  new_polygons <- append(new_polygons, list(result_rectangle_boundary))

  # Remove processed result
  result <- result[result$cluster != cl, ]
}
```

```{r}
flat_polygons <- do.call(c, new_polygons)
# Create a valid geometry collection
polygon_sfc <- st_sfc(flat_polygons, crs = st_crs(boundary))
# Convert to sf object
polygon_sf <- st_as_sf(polygon_sfc)
```
